decisions.decision: Adopt idempotent retries with a client dedupe key (Option A); do not build the server dedupe table
decisions.rationale: Option B would block two legitimate payments of the same amount within the time window, and the gateway already supports an idempotency key header so only clients need to send it

summary.summary: Architecture review on idempotent retries for payment requests. The team chose Option A (client-sent dedupe key) over Option B (server-side dedupe table) due to false-positive risk and existing gateway support. Rollout will start with the web client, followed by the mobile client. Jun to write the ADR by Wednesday, Theo to update the reconciliation job, Mira to own the rollout plan, and Me to write the stakeholder update for the support team.
